title: s2_4_dependency_refresh_attestation_v1
description: Evidence-only S2.4 §9.2 dependency-freshness refresh. It is the ONLY mechanism by which an expired S2.2A compatibility, S2.3 sealed-build/expected-identity or S1.3 contract SOURCE identity may still be admitted, and it carries NO caller status/admitted/pass/done field (this closed schema simply omits them): the central validator DERIVES DEPENDENCY_REFRESH_ADMITTED by INDEPENDENTLY replaying the original producer's semantic checks against the repository at current_source_head and comparing the result with BOTH the reproduced_semantic_digests claimed here AND the original receipt's own values. A refresh that merely re-asserts the original digest cannot be produced: its evidentiary content is recomputed by the verifier, never accepted from the caller. §9.2's hard line is enforced elsewhere by the same gate — S2.0 effect, pg_topology_attestation_v1, capability-probe/network-sandbox, prepared-bundle and every operator authorization are NEVER refreshable by reference and must be freshly observed or newly signed. original_schema_version is a closed enum that does not contain this schema, so a refresh can never refresh another refresh. No SSHSIG: §9.2 requires independent recomputation, not a signature, and §9.1 fixes exactly four domain-separated profiles, none of which is a refresh (see the module docstring in aiml_gate_receipt_s2_4_contracts.py). Source-seam evidence only: the nine authorities stay false, production_apply_performed false and running_attested false, and no refresh ever substitutes for a runtime observation.
